# HOA Contracts

> **Carriers are dropping HOAs and condo associations, and premiums keep climbing.** HOA Contracts gives association boards a **FREE, no-obligation, board-ready review** from a **licensed broker** — premium savings, coverage gaps, directors & officers (D&O), deductibles, and replacement cost — **before renewal**. 4,000+ communities served · $3B+ in coverage reviewed · 38 states. Call **(208) 361-4295**.

- [Insurance for HOA Board Members — D&O & Directors & Officers](https://hoacontracts.com/hoa-board-liability-insurance.html): Free review of HOA directors & officers (D&O) liability coverage. Protect board members from personal exposure for decisions made on behalf of the association.

We benchmark your association's master policy for premium savings, coverage gaps, replacement cost accuracy, and competitive carrier options before renewal.
- [Condo Association Insurance](https://hoacontracts.com/condo-association-insurance.html): Free condo association (COA) insurance review. Benchmark your condo master policy for premium savings, coverage gaps, replacement cost, and deductible exposure before renewal.
- [HOA Coverage Gap Review](https://hoacontracts.com/coverage-gap-review.html): Free HOA coverage gap review. Evaluate your association's policy limits against real-world replacement and exposure risks to find gaps before a claim does.
- [HOA Replacement Cost Analysis](https://hoacontracts.com/hoa-replacement-cost-analysis.html): Free HOA replacement cost review. Identify underinsured buildings and outdated valuations before a claim exposes the gap between your coverage and rebuild costs.
- [HOA Insurance Carrier Review](https://hoacontracts.com/hoa-insurance-carrier-review.html): How to compare HOA insurance carriers — coverage structure, pricing, and renewal strategy — so your association isn't auto-renewing with the wrong market.
